reason: The plugin is primarily a ROS2 diagnostics and debugging assistant integrated with DeepSeek Harness: it exposes many ROS2 inspection commands for read-only troubleshooting and adds optional, approval-gated management actions, with an additional layer for launching/observing ROS GUIs and automating local GUI interaction. This user-facing scope is robot/system debugging rather than general-purpose generation or content tooling, so its primary category is testing-debugging with conservative high-risk handling due to command execution and local automation capabilities.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ROS2 诊断与联合调试能力，可进行节点/话题/服务/参数与 TF 检查、拓扑与 Bag 信息读取，并在用户授权后执行构建、参数设置、录包及 GUI 观测操作。
summaries.en: This plugin provides DeepSeek Harness with ROS2 diagnostics and debugging capabilities, covering inspection of nodes, topics, services, parameters, TF, graph, and bag info, and enabling build/install/parameter/recording workflows plus optional GUI observation and interaction after user approval.

capabilities: Executes ROS2/colcon/rosdep commands on the host via CLI wrappers
Provides read-only diagnostics for ROS graph, topics, services, actions, params, TF, and bag metadata
Provides approval-gated write operations including builds, dependency installation, message skeleton creation, parameter setting, and bag recording
Controls local GUI sessions with process launch, screenshot capture, and input actions (click/drag/keyboard)
Supports optional external vision-provider calls when a provider is configured

reasons.code: README defines an L1 read-only diagnostics layer and an L2 approval-gated management layer using host ROS2/colcon/rosdep commands.
L2 actions include build, rosdep install, parameter setting, message skeleton creation, and bounded bag recording, which can modify workspace/system state.
README documents GUI lifecycle tools plus xdotool/wmctrl-based interaction and screenshot capture, indicating local computer control capability.
Vision features are configurable for mock/Gemini/OpenAI and include API key and endpoint settings, indicating potential outbound network usage.
